This GEMM is memory-bound: with M=1 it is a GEMV-like operation, so the time is set by streaming the weight matrix from HBM.

Weight size: 28672 × 4096 × 2 bytes = 234.9 MB (about 235 MB).

B300 HBM3e bandwidth is nominally 8 TB/s. Achievable bandwidth for a streaming read is roughly 6.5–7 TB/s, or about 85% of peak.

Time at ~7 TB/s: 234.9 MB / 7 TB/s ≈ 33.5 µs. At the 8 TB/s peak it would be about 29 µs.

cuBLAS at M=1 usually reaches somewhat less than ideal streaming bandwidth, and a launch plus tail adds a few µs even inside a CUDA graph. A realistic figure is about 38 µs.
